title: Meet the keyboard
goal: Tell the white and black keys apart and find every C.

steps.title: Your keyboard
steps.text: A piano has long white keys and short black keys. Press a few keys and listen. Then press right to carry on.

steps.title: Groups of black keys
steps.text: The black keys come in little groups: two, then three, then two, then three. Look at the numbers above the keys.

steps.title: Finding C
steps.text: Find a group of two black keys. The white key just to the left of that group is called C. Every C is lit now.

steps.title: Middle C
steps.text: The C closest to the middle of your keyboard is called middle C. It is lit now. You will use it all the time.

steps.title: High and low
steps.text: Keys to the right sound higher. Keys to the left sound lower. Try some from both ends, then press right.
